slot_metadata.target_region: Buea / Mount Cameroon Slopes, Southwest Region, Cameroon
slot_metadata.agroecological_zone: Humid Forest with Bimodal Rainfall / Volcanic Uplands

labor_structure.mechanization_level: Semi-mechanized (Knapsack sprayers, motorized weeders/tillers where accessible)

tillage_practice.type: Conservation tillage / Contour ridging with tied ridges
tillage_practice.erosion_control: Stripe cropping, cover cropping, and biological bunds
tillage_practice.residue_management: In-situ chopping and deep incorporation or uniform surface mulching

cropping_system_and_phenology.cropping_pattern: Optimized Row Intercropping (Certified Hybrids + Disease-Free Planting Material)

season_1_first_rains.sowing_window: March 1 - March 25 (Early planting with first reliable rains)
season_1_first_rains.establishment_method: Precision dibbling / Certified seed treatment (fungicide/insecticide seed dressing)

inorganic_use.application_method: Band placement / Deep placement with soil cover

organic_use.source: Composted farmyard manure combined with green manure cover crops (Mucuna/Pueraria)

weed_control.method: Integrated Weed Management (Pre-emergence herbicide + Targeted mechanical/hand weeding)

pest_and_disease_management.scouting_method: Scheduled weekly agronomic scouting using economic threshold levels (ETL)

common_agents: Emamectin benzoate / Flubendiamide (Systematic Fall Armyworm control)
chemical_pesticides.application_equipment: Calibrated motorized or high-pressure knapsack sprayers with drift guards

water_and_irrigation.water_source: Natural precipitation supplemented by soil moisture retention trenches

harvest_and_post_harvest.harvesting_method: Timely physiological maturity harvesting using clean, sanitized tools
harvest_and_post_harvest.post_harvest_handling: Purdue Improved Crop Storage (PICS) bags for maize; solar drying units for roots/tubers
